children: Victoria, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - October 14, 2026) - Southstone Minerals Limited
") is pleased to announce that it has filed and is in the process of mailing its management information circular (the "
") and related materials for the special meeting (the "
") of common shares in the capital of Southstone (the "
") to be held at 10:00 a.m. (Vancouver time) on November 12, 2026.
At the Meeting, Shareholders will be asked to approve the previously announced plan of arrangement under the
") pursuant to which Terry L. Tucker, the Company's Executive Chairman and Interim Chief Executive Officer (the "
") will acquire all of the issued and outstanding Shares that he does not already own for cash consideration of $0.0375 per Share (the "
"). Shareholders will also be asked to approve a resolution to delist the Shares from the TSX Venture Exchange (the "
The Board of Directors of Southstone (the "
") has undertaken a thorough review of the Arrangement and consulted with its financial and legal advisors, and received a unanimous recommendation of the special committee of the Board (the "

"), that the Arrangement is in the best interests of Southstone and that the Consideration to be received by Shareholders pursuant to the Arrangement is fair to Shareholders. The Special Committee's recommendation was informed by the receipt of a fairness opinion from Evans & Evans, Inc., the financial advisor to the Special Committee (the "

"). Accordingly, the Board has unanimously (with the Purchaser abstaining) approved the Arrangement and recommends that Shareholders vote FOR the Arrangement and that disinterested Shareholders vote FOR the Delisting Resolution.
In reaching the conclusion to recommend that Shareholders vote FOR the Arrangement, the Board carefully considered a number of factors, including, among others, the following:
. The consideration to be paid to Shareholders will be comprised entirely of cash thereby providing Shareholders with immediate liquidity and certainty of value.

. Trading in the Shares has been subject to low volumes and infrequency of trades both prior to the halt in trading on January 10, 2024 and subsequent to reinstatement for trading on July 27, 2026, indicating that the ability of a large number of Shareholders to realize the current trading price for their Shares is highly unlikely.
. The Financial Advisor provided its opinion (the "

") to the Special Committee to the effect that, as of September 21, 2026, and subject to the assumptions, limitations and qualifications set out in the Fairness Opinion, the Arrangement and Consideration are fair, from a financial point of view, to the Shareholders.
A full description of the factors considered by the Special Committee and the Board is included in the Circular under the heading "Reasons for the Recommendation".
On October 9, 2026, the Company obtained an interim order of the Supreme Court of British Columbia (the "
") providing for the calling and holding of the Meeting, the granting of dissent rights and addressing other procedural matters related to the Arrangement and the conduct of the Meeting (the "
"). A copy of the Interim Order is attached as Schedule E to the Circular.

The Meeting will be held in person at the office of McMillan LLP, counsel to Southstone, at 1500 - 1055 West Georgia Street, Vancouver, BC V6E 4N7 at 10:00 a.m. (Vancouver time) on November 12, 2026. The Board has fixed the close of business on October 2, 2026 as the record date for the determination of Shareholders entitled to receive notice of and vote at the Meeting (the "

To be effective, the Arrangement must be approved by: (i) not less than 66⅔% of the votes cast by Shareholders present in person or represented by proxy at the Meeting, and (ii) a simple majority of the votes cast by Shareholders, excluding the Purchaser and any other persons required to be excluded under Multilateral Instrument 61-101 -
Protection of Minority Security Holders in Special Transactions
, in each case voting in accordance with the Interim Order.

The Circular contains, among other things, details concerning the Arrangement, the background to and reasons for the Board and Special Committee recommendations, the requirements for the Arrangement to become effective, the procedure for receiving consideration payable under the Arrangement, procedures for voting at the Meeting and other related matters. Shareholders are urged to carefully review the Circular and related Meeting materials as they contain important information regarding the Arrangement and its consequences to Shareholders. Copies of the Circular and related Meeting materials are available under the Company's SEDAR+ profile at

The closing of the Arrangement is subject to the satisfaction or waiver (where applicable) of certain customary closing conditions, including receipt of Shareholder approval, receipt of the final approval of the Court and the final acceptance of the TSX Venture Exchange (the "

"). The TSXV conditionally accepted the Arrangement on October 13, 2026. Assuming all conditions are satisfied or waived, it is expected that the Arrangement will be completed in the fourth quarter of 2026.

Registered Shareholders as of the Record Date can vote by attending the Meeting in person or by completing, dating and signing the form of proxy enclosed with the Circular and returning it to the Company's transfer agent, TSX Trust Company, online by following the instructions set out on the proxy form at

, by facsimile to 1-416-595-9593 or by mail at 301 - 100 Adelaide Street West, Toronto, ON, M5H 4H1, Attention: Proxy Department. In order to be valid and acted upon at the Meeting, a properly executed proxy must be received by 10:00 a.m. (Vancouver time) on November 10, 2026, or in the event the Meeting is adjourned or postponed, not less than 48 hours (excluding Saturdays, Sundays and holidays) prior to the time set for any reconvened or postponed Meeting.

Non-registered beneficial Shareholders as of the Record Date, being Shareholders who hold Shares through a broker, bank or other intermediary, will receive a voting instruction form from Broadridge Financial Solutions, Inc. ("

"). Broadridge typically prepares a voting instruction form with a 16-digit control number that it delivers to non-registered (beneficial) Shareholders and asks them to return instructions directly to Broadridge. For your Shares to be voted, you must follow the instructions on the voting instruction form that is provided to you. The voting instruction form must be returned to Broadridge well in advance of the Meeting to ensure that Shares are voted.
Shareholders with questions or who require voting assistance may contact Southstone's proxy solicitation agent:
